displayName: Orshot Social Media Scheduler: schedule posts, post to Instagram, LinkedIn, X, TikTok, Facebook, Pinterest, Threads, Bluesky, Reddit, YouTube, Telegram, Snapchat and Google Business from templates
description: Social media scheduler and social media automation for AI agents. Schedule posts, post to Instagram, post to LinkedIn, X, TikTok, Facebook, Pinterest, Threads, Bluesky, Reddit, YouTube, Telegram, Snapchat and Google Business with Orshot, with the image, carousel or video rendered from a template in the same call. Run a weekly content calendar, queue drafts for review, read post analytics and follower growth, and find the best time to post. Hosted MCP server (OAuth), REST for headless jobs.

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent validate API outcomes instead of assuming success?
Did the agent preserve evidence for request/response behavior and error handling?
